description: No spec subject (candidates: specled.verification docs surface when picked up). Severity: Medium. From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. spec.check --run-commands executes verification commands defined in repo-resident spec files; in a CI configured to run on fork PRs this executes attacker-authored shell with the workflow token. Keep-reason: docs/policy deliverable (threat-model statement + recommended CI gating for public repos), not a code fix on the shipped branch. Concrete failure: a public repo running armed spec.check on pull_request from forks grants fork authors arbitrary command execution in CI.
title: F12: --run-commands executes repo-resident shell — document fork-PR CI trust policy
